As a new stationary source, the gasification facility would be restricted to certain incremental increases, as outlined by the EPA, for the prevention of significant deterioration of the air quality of the region (Federal Register volume 39, No. 235). The allowable incremental increases for Class I, II, and III areas are presented in Table III-16. The Project Area lies in a Class II area and calculated effluent concentrations resulting from the stack released emissions were also compared to the Class II allowable increments.
